risks.note: Rapid technological advancement may impact product relevance and competitiveness, and continuous change may require substantial investment in product development, innovation and upgradation of existing solutions. Named as the first row of the Company's Enterprise Risk Management framework; mitigation is continuous product enhancement, R&D and adoption of emerging technologies.

Cyber threats, data breaches and system vulnerabilities may affect business continuity and customer confidence. Structural for a company whose core products carry examination papers and institutional student data; the Board's risk-management note lists cyber security threats, data protection and information security among the risks it continuously evaluates.

The software and IT services industry is highly competitive with domestic and international players offering similar products; management states competition may impact pricing, market share and profitability, and lists 'pricing pressure' from growing competition and changing customer expectations as a separate threat to margins.

Delays in technology spending, procurement cycles or budgetary constraints among educational institutions and enterprises may affect business growth; the ERM framework separately flags 'Customer Procurement & Revenue Cycle' — delays in procurement approvals and decision-making may impact project execution and revenue realization. Compounded by the concentration of the order book in government and university tenders (e.g. Government of Gujarat and Barkatullah University orders) and only 07 tenders awarded during the year.
risks.risk: Dependence on institutional, enterprise and government spending cycles

risks.note: The Board's risk-management note explicitly lists 'client dependency' among the risks continuously evaluated. Separately, the shareholder notice seeks approval for related-party transactions with associate Infinity Transoft Solution Private Limited (49.42% held) whose proposed limit equals 63.10% of the Company's audited consolidated annual turnover for FY 2025-26 — a very large share of activity routed through a single related counterparty, even though it is stated to be in the ordinary course and at arm's length.

The technology sector faces intense competition for skilled professionals, which may impact retention and increase employee costs; the ERM framework flags that challenges in attracting and retaining skilled professionals may affect growth and service delivery. Reported employee attrition was 16.55% and employee benefit expenses rose in line with business expansion.

Changes in laws, regulations, data-protection requirements and industry standards may increase compliance obligations and operational costs. Elevated by the Company's move from an unlisted public company to a listed entity on the SME Platform of BSE on 08 October 2025, which brings the SEBI Listing Regulations regime.

Macroeconomic challenges, inflationary pressures and geopolitical developments may influence customer spending patterns and investment decisions — relevant given the discretionary, project-led nature of ERP and examination-technology purchases.
